entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Jeu dun perdetga, o miu Diu, che Ti has creau mei per renconuscher Tei e per adurar Tei.
Jeu attestel en quel mument mia fleivlezia e Tia pussonza, mia paupradat e Tia rihezia. Ei dat negin auter Diu dano Tei, il qual gida el prighel, il qual subsista en sesez.
